Massachusetts Electric Company and Nantucket Electric Company, each d/b/a National Grid

Massachusetts Electric Company and Nantucket Electric Company d/b/a National Grid submits National Grid’s Basic Service filing for the periods May 1, 2023 through October 31, 2023 for the residential and commercial customer groups and May 1, 2023 through July 31, 2023 for the industrial customer group.
Massachusetts Electric Company and Nantucket Electric Company, each d/b/a National Grid

Company's Notice of Withdrawal of its Petition for Pre-Approval of an Alternative Procurement and Pricing Plan for Basic Service supply that was submitted to the Department of Public Utilities on February 8, 2023.
Massachusetts Electric Company and Nantucket Electric Company, each d/b/a National Grid

Massachusetts Electric Company and Nantucket Electric Company d/b/a National Grid (“National Grid”), a Petition for Pre-Approval of an Alternative Procurement and Pricing Plan for Basic Service supply for the period May 1, 2023 through July 31, 2023 for the Company’s General Service – Demand G-2 customers and General Service – Time-of-Use G-3 customers, and for the period May 1, 2023 through October 31, 2023 for the Company’s residential, General Service – Small Commercial and Industrial G-1, and streetlighting customers. Also attached are Exhibit NG-1, the Company’s testimony in support of the Petition, as well as affidavits, and appearance of counsel. By Maebh Purcell DPU 23-BSF-D1.
